title: Liquidation Price Calculator for Perps & Margin | Deploy
description: Find the liquidation price of a leveraged long or short, or the margin call price on a stock margin account. Uses Hyperliquid maintenance rules.
intro: Find where a leveraged position gets liquidated (perpetuals) or hits a margin call (stocks on margin).

jsonLd.name: Liquidation Price Calculator
jsonLd.description: Find the liquidation price of a leveraged long or short, or the margin call price on a stock margin account. Uses Hyperliquid maintenance rules.

exampleHtml:
Example: Liquidation Price calculation

Using these inputs:

  • Market: Perpetual futures
  • Direction: Long
  • Entry price: $60,000
  • Leverage: 10 ×
  • Position value: $1,000
  • Market max leverage: 40× (maintenance 1.25%)

The calculator returns:

  • Liquidation price: $54,683.54 (8.86% below entry)
  • Distance to liquidation: 8.86%
  • Maintenance margin: 1.25%
  • Initial margin: $100.00
  • Loss at that price: −$88.61 (88.61% of margin)
